PLEASANTON UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT • TRUSTEE AREA 5
# Save Our Schools. Secure Our Future.
Independent legal and fiscal oversight to protect neighborhood classrooms, eliminate administrative waste, and keep our schools safe for every student.
As a father of two young kids at Hearst Elementary and a weekly classroom volunteer, our schools are deeply personal to me. Having stood at the podium meeting after meeting to challenge 76+ frontline layoffs and organizing over 150 neighbors at SaveHearst.com, I am running to bring transparency, accountability, and classroom-first leadership back to PUSD.

Platform & Action Plan
## Platform Priorities: Accountability, Excellence & Preservation
Actionable commitments and proven public testimony from Thomas Choi to protect classroom resources, restore fiscal health, and defend neighborhood schools.
PRIORITY 1: FISCAL RESPONSIBILITY
### Classroom-First Fiscal Responsibility & Independent Oversight
$20M Emergency Loan
Operating under state negative certification while committing $23.5M to acquire and $8M to renovate central headquarters and $12M for outside consulting contracts.
Thomas brings forensic budget examination to stop administrative bloat, conduct independent contract audits, and ensure tax dollars protect classroom instruction.
✓ Forensic Contract Audits: Audit $12M in outside consulting fees ($500–$900/hr retainers) before cutting school staff.
✓ Protect Frontline Educators: Halt repeat layoffs after 76+ positions eliminated and freeze executive pay first.
Watch Board Testimony ↗
Starts at 02:15:11
PRIORITY 2: ACADEMIC EXCELLENCE
### Academic Excellence, Innovation & Partnerships
Zero Taxpayer Cost
Expanding tuition-free dual-enrollment college credits with Las Positas College and regional Tri-Valley STEM apprenticeships.
We cannot cut our way to excellence. Securing our children's future requires investing directly into classroom innovation and specialist retention.
✓ Hands-On STEM & CTE: Robotics, biotechnology, coding, and vocational pathways that attract and retain families.
✓ Specialist Retention: Safeguard dedicated reading interventionists, math specialists, counselors, and librarians.
Watch Program Testimony ↗
Specialist Roles
PRIORITY 3: CAMPUS PRESERVATION
### Neighborhood Safety & Campus Preservation
160+ Signatures
Organized SaveHearst.com to stop an industrial maintenance depot on elementary playfields and preserve student recreational green space.
Transparent governance that protects neighborhood schools, ensures child traffic safety, and respects established residential zoning.
✓ Protect Elementary Playfields: Enforce CA Government Code preventing industrial zoning overrides on campuses.
✓ Safe School Routes: Keep heavy maintenance vehicle fleets away from elementary and middle school crosswalks.
Watch Hearst Testimony ↗
Starts at 00:38:25

### Thomas Choi
Candidate for PUSD Trustee Area 5
CA Bar #309821 Electrical Engineer Hearst Parent
#### Independent Oversight, Technical Precision & Genuine Community Roots
Thomas Choi is a licensed California patent attorney (State Bar #309821) and electrical engineer with over a decade of experience analyzing complex technical systems, reviewing high-stakes contracts, and managing fiduciary obligations.
As an Area 5 parent with two children attending Hearst Elementary and a weekly classroom volunteer, Thomas experienced firsthand the consequences of district mismanagement when PUSD abruptly eliminated 76+ frontline educators and staff while continuing millions in administrative consulting contracts.
Thomas founded SaveHearst.com to organize over 150 local families in protecting student green playfields from an ill-conceived maintenance bus yard relocation. On the School Board, Thomas will apply the same forensic rigor and unwavering independence to protect classrooms, balance budgets, and keep our neighborhood schools thriving.
“My commitment is simple: bring independent oversight to save our neighborhood schools, protect frontline educators, and restore the fiscal discipline needed to secure our children’s future.”
TC
#### Thomas Choi
Candidate for PUSD Board of Trustees • Area 5
Grassroots Coalition • SaveHearst.com
## SaveHearst.com Coalition: Parents & Neighbors Standing Together
When PUSD leadership proposed eliminating student playfields at Hearst Elementary and Pleasanton Middle School to build an industrial maintenance bus yard, Thomas Choi helped organize over 160 neighborhood families to demand commercial alternatives, protect child traffic safety, and safeguard green space.
Grassroots Victory in Action • 160+ Area 5 Signatures
### Protecting Hearst & PMS Playfields for Our Children
SaveHearst.com demonstrated what dedicated parent advocacy can achieve. By holding leadership accountable to public records and zoning regulations, neighbors preserved daily recess and physical education areas for hundreds of elementary students.
Zero Diesel Bus Depots on Campuses Child Pedestrian & Bike Safety Preserving Recess Green Space
Visit SaveHearst.com ↗
Health & Safety Advocacy ✓
“Placing an industrial bus and maintenance operations yard next to two school campuses puts real estate revenue ahead of children's safety and health. State air-quality guidance recommends keeping diesel fleet traffic away from schools. Student safety and green space must come before commercial income.”
#### Parent of a Young Child at Hearst
Hearst Family & Area 5 Neighbor
PTA & Pedestrian Safety ✓
“As a Hearst parent and PTA member, I strongly oppose heavy maintenance traffic outside our school. Families already arrive 15 minutes early just to park safely. Cutting student play space in half to solve the district's commercial planning issues is completely wrong. Thomas Choi stepped forward with real answers.”
#### Hearst PTA Member & Resident
Hearst Elementary & Case Ave Community
